# RandomFieldDisorder

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Quenched spatial randomness in local fields that breaks translational symmetry and induces domain pinning. Mimics fabrication imperfections in physical computing substrates, guiding design of fault-tolerant TCC/iNEST systems.
